jobs.description: Looking for a stable, well-paid job in production where you can work with your hands and make a real impact? Join MGG in Tegelen as a Production Worker (Grinder) and become an essential part of the manufacturing process. In this role, you will grind, finish, and inspect aluminum products to ensure they meet the highest quality standards. This is a physically active position in a 3-shift system, including night shifts, making it ideal for people who enjoy practical, hands-on work and are not afraid of a challenge. Wie zoeken we? Live near Tegelen and have your own accommodation and transport Have experience working in a 3-shift system (or at least night shifts) Speak English, German, or Dutch Wat bieden wij je? €20.18 gross per hour including allowances (see below how it is calculated) Full-time job of 37,5 hours per week in 3 shifts Travel allowance Long-term, stable work Chance of a permanent contract in the future Opportunity to develop your technical skills How is the salary calculated? The basic hourly wage is €16.06. You will receive a 120% bonus for all hours worked, whether you work early, late, or night shifts. €16.06 x 120% = €19.27. On top of that, you will also receive €0.91 in ADV per hour worked: €19.27 + €0.91 = €20.18 gross per hour. Functieomschrijving This job is perfect for you if you like hands-on work that keeps you active during your shift. Your workday will consist of: Grinding and finishing aluminum products Working with tools and machines Loading products into machines and robots Checking product quality It's a plus if you have worked in metal of construction or other production areas, but technical experience is not required. You will work in a 3-shift system that consists of the following working hours: 5:45 AM – 1:45 PM, 1:45 PM – 9:45 PM, 9:45 PM – 5:45 AM. Apply now and become part of the team at MGG in Tegelen!

We are looking for young film critics! 
Cinekid is looking for English-speaking children between 4 - 14 years to join 'Ask Your Audience' in smaller focus groups. We are looking for young film critics! 
During Cinekid for Professionals this October, international filmmakers get the opportunity to present their new projects to the most important audience: kids themselves. 'Ask Your Audience' is a unique opportunity for children who love storytelling and movies, to have a real impact on the films and shows they will be watching in the future. 
 Who are we looking for? 
We are looking for English-speaking children or school groups between the ages 4 to 14. They will be joining smaller focus groups, depending on their age. After a quick presentation by selected filmmakers, kids will have the opportunity to ask questions about anything related to the project as well as share their opinions. A moderator will guide the sessions, to support a valuable exchange between the filmmakers and their young critics. 
 When and where will it happen? 
Ask Your Audience will take place during Cinekid Festival at Pathé Amsterdam Noord on 21, 22 and 23 October . Children will join us for 1 - 2 hours, depending on their age. We will share a more detailed schedule closer to the event. 
 What can we offer? 
To thank the children for their feedback, we can offer them the full Cinekid Festival experience; a complementary ticket for a festival screening and access to the MediaLab. 
 How can you apply? 
If your child is interested in participating or you would like to get more information about the programme, please contact us at professionals@cinekid.nl with the subject 'Ask Your Audience 2025'. Please include the age of your child and sign up before 24 September.
